messages:
anna (sec): Heads-up: public disclosure landed for CVE-2026-1001 affecting tokenizers wheel builds. We see failures in macOS CI and some downstream FastAPI apps when the wheel is installed via pip. Repro steps attached.

ryan (eng): Thanks. Can you paste the failing pip error?

anna (sec): Sure — from the mac-setup job:
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for tokenizers which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly
Collecting tokenizers==0.12.1
  Building wheel for tokenizers (pyproject.toml) ... error
  RuntimeError: incompatible rustc toolchain
```

maria (eng-ml): Tokenizers maintainers released 0.13.4 with a CVE patch and manylinux wheels. We should prefer the wheel release instead of forcing local build.

dave (infra): CI shows we pinned tokenizers in the constraints file to 0.12.x for reproducibility. That explains the source build attempt.

anna (sec): Proposal: regenerate poetry.lock to allow tokenizers>=0.13.4, update constraints.txt used by our Docker images, and add an advisory note to dependencies tracker. Steps: 1) regen lock (no other updates), 2) run full CI, 3) open canary on dedicated and staging.

ryan (eng): I can do the lock regen. Quick question: do we run `poetry lock --no-update` or full update? If tokenizers is transitive it might require updating transformers.

maria (eng-ml): transformers 4.34+ is fine with tokenizers 0.13.4. But older pinned transformers 4.28 might not. We should run `poetry lock -n` then run `pip-compile`-style check.

anna (sec): Operational constraints: security wants minimal churn. So prefer minimal bumps. If regen forces transformers bump, call out in release notes and get signoff.

ryan (eng): I'll try minimal change first: `poetry add tokenizers@^0.13.4 --lock` and then `poetry lock` to update only that dependency.

dave (infra): Also update constraints.txt used by our build images:
```
# update step
poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes -o /tmp/reqs.txt
python tools/generate_constraints.py /tmp/reqs.txt > docker/constraints.txt
```

ci-bot: CI job mac-setup #482 failed: https://ci.example.com/builds/482 (failing on tokenizers build) :rotating_light:

maria (eng-ml): One more caveat: some downstream repos vendor an older tokenizers in their subdeps. We'll run an org-wide search for `tokenizers==0.12` and open companion PRs where needed.

anna (sec): Risk tracking: add CVE-2026-1001 to the vuln board, severity MEDIUM, and mark the remediation sprint. Also add a regression test that pulls the manylinux wheel to ensure no source-build fallback job.

ryan (eng): Action log:
- @ryan: open PR on platform to bump tokenizers to >=0.13.4 and regen poetry.lock (PR: draft)
- @dave: update docker constraints and trigger rebuild of build images
- @maria: run org search for older tokenizers pins and draft follow-up PRs
- @anna: add CVE and review release notes + approve minimal-change plan

ryan (eng): Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-platform/pull/789 (WIP) — includes `poetry add tokenizers@^0.13.4 --lock` and updated constraints.

dave (infra): I'll queue a canary build once the PR lands. Suggest gating the canary on: unit tests, mac-setup, and model-serving smoke tests.

maria (eng-ml): I ran quick local test with transformers pinned at 4.28 and tokenizers 0.13.4 — small API deprecation warnings but no runtime break. Useful to add a quick eval run on a small prompt set.

anna (sec): Approved to proceed with minimal bump. If CI surfaces transformer incompatibility, revert and escalate to security leadership.

ci-bot: mac-setup job re-run queued for PR 789 -> https://ci.example.com/builds/490 :white_check_mark:

ryan (eng): CI green on PR 789, mac-setup and linux builds pass. Merging after 1 more review.

anna (sec): Thanks. After merge: backport PR to 1.x (patch branch) and notify customers on dedicated about a short rolling restart for new image.

dave (infra): Backport PR #790 created. Scheduling image rebuild at 03:00 UTC and rolling deploy to staging then prod window.

maria (eng-ml): Follow-ups: add an automated scan to the vulnerability pipeline that flags builds attempting source-builds of tokenizers/transformers on mac runners.

anna (sec): Closing the thread when backport is deployed and advisory posted. :lock:
